offers_products.reason: Manufactures lithium-ion cells, modules, battery packs and energy storage systems for commercial vehicles and equipment.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from battery systems; any support or warranty is incidental to products sold.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells batteries to vehicle makers, heavy equipment and energy storage customers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are bus, truck and equipment manufacturers and energy storage buyers, all businesses.

recurring_revenue.reason: Battery packs are sold per vehicle program or project order; lumpy OEM orders rather than subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Commercial vehicle and equipment electrification purchases and ESS projects can be deferred in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Battery packs and energy storage systems are large, infrequent purchases for fleet, vehicle and project buyers.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured battery products and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large bus, truck and heavy equipment OEMs and large energy storage developers.

asset_heavy.reason: Vertically integrated cell, cathode, anode and electrolyte manufacturing plants in the U.S., China and Germany need heavy capital investment.
